evals.name: pi0-clean
evals.prompt: I'm putting together the project page for our latest paper. Can you fill in template.yaml from https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.24164 ? Grab a teaser and the method figure into public/ too, and give me a short TL;DR.
evals.expected_output: template.yaml filled with the pi0 paper's title, all authors, abstract in overview, a 1-2 sentence TL;DR in description, resources.paper set to the abs url, a bibtex entry, teaser + method images downloaded to public/, and the paper's table converted to uk-table HTML in a body section. Repo-specific fields (theme, organization, header, projects) preserved.
assertions: template.yaml parses as valid YAML
title field contains the paper's real title
resources.paper is set to the arXiv abs URL for this paper
description is a short TL;DR: non-empty, <= ~60 words, and shorter than the abstract (not a copy of it)
overview field is non-empty and reflects the paper's abstract
bibtex field contains the correct arXiv id
authors list is populated with the paper's authors (roughly the right count, first author correct)
the teaser field names an image file that actually exists in the saved outputs
at least one body section contains a converted uk-table HTML table (class 'uk-table')
repo-specific fields (theme, organization, twitter) are preserved unchanged from the original template

evals.name: pdf-local-draft
evals.prompt: our IROS submission isn't on arxiv yet, the draft is at draft.pdf in the repo root. can you fill in template.yaml from it — teaser + method figures into public/, a TL;DR, and the results tables as proper html tables?
evals.expected_output: template.yaml filled from the local PDF: title/authors/affiliations/abstract read from the draft's front matter, teaser and method figures cropped from the pages by caption into public/, the paper's tables converted to uk-table HTML in a Results body section, and every field the PDF can't supply (paper URL, conference, bibtex venue) left empty with a TODO(human) marker instead of the previous example paper's values.
assertions: template.yaml parses as valid YAML
title field contains the paper's real title as printed on page 1
description is a short TL;DR: non-empty, <= ~60 words, and shorter than the abstract (not a copy of it)
overview field is non-empty and reflects the paper's abstract, with no words welded together by a dropped hyphen (e.g. 'phasespecific')
authors list is populated with all six authors in paper order, first author correct
authors carry the affiliation indices from their superscripts, and the affiliations list names the institutions from the page-1 footnotes
the teaser field names an image file that actually exists in the saved outputs, and the teaser is a cropped figure (not a whole rendered page)
at least one body section contains a uk-table HTML table converted from a PDF table, with the right number of columns and correct numbers
repo-specific fields (theme, organization, twitter, projects) are preserved unchanged from the original template
no field still holds the previous example paper's data (no 'multipolar' / MULTIPOLAR links or bibtex left anywhere)
fields the PDF cannot supply (resources.paper, conference, bibtex venue) are empty or marked TODO(human) rather than guessed or left stale
